GoGo

Overview

GoGo comes to the human village to recover the First Goblin. He explains the traditions surrounding its blue Eye Stone and the written record seized from him by orcs. Persistent even when threatened, he offers a magical doll in exchange for the head he wants returned. [1, 2]

Two searches on the islands

The river islands hold two different leads. Estera needs the Orb, which Erfar places on the southernmost island. Erfar also proposes tracing GoGo’s blue Eye Stone to a possible portal. Zak takes the First Goblin’s skull to compel GoGo to visit the village; the chief explains that the orcs confiscated the written record of the stone’s origin. The islands require their own bridge mechanism, distinct from the cave’s. Zak retrieves the record and the Orb in this area. Erfar claims the record offers nothing useful, then diverts attention to missing taxes and gold in Golden Valley. His portal scheme and Estera’s search serve different purposes, even though they take Zak through the same territory. [3, 1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10]
